name: comsol-cae-plugin
description: Production-grade CAE automation, introspection, parametric mutation, and solver orchestration for COMSOL Multiphysics.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect, mutate parameters, and solve COMSOL models safely
interface.longDescription: Automates heavy industrial simulations in COMSOL Multiphysics via official Java API and Subprocess Bridge. Enforces Copy-on-Write immutability, floating license queueing, and heavy data downsampling.
capabilities: Deep model tree reflection (tags, domains, physics)
Copy-on-Write parameter variation with SHA-256 validation
Asynchronous study solving with progress streaming
Lightweight KPI and 2D diagnostic image extraction
defaultPrompt: Inspect the baseline cylinder model case/cylinder_flow.mph and report active physics tags.
Run a parameter sweep on inlet velocity U_mean from 0.8 to 1.2 m/s using Copy-on-Write.
Solve study std1 and extract the 2D vorticity contour without dumping raw 3D mesh fields.
